name: solidity-foundry-boilerplate
description: Production ready Solidity boilerplate with Foundry
author: Pacto

scripts.commit: pnpm lint:check && pnpm lint:natspec && pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:integration
scripts.deploy:mainnet: bash -c 'source .env && forge script Deploy --rpc-url mainnet --account $MAINNET_DEPLOYER_NAME --broadcast --verify --chain mainnet -vvvvv'
scripts.deploy:sepolia: bash -c 'source .env && forge script Deploy --rpc-url sepolia --account $SEPOLIA_DEPLOYER_NAME --broadcast --verify --chain sepolia -vvvvv'
scripts.deploy:squad-admin-ext:mainnet: bash -c 'source .env && forge script DeploySquadAdminExtStandalone --rpc-url mainnet --account $MAINNET_DEPLOYER_NAME --broadcast --chain mainnet -vvvv'
scripts.deploy:squad-admin-ext:sepolia: bash -c 'source .env && forge script DeploySquadAdminExtStandalone --rpc-url sepolia --account $SEPOLIA_DEPLOYER_NAME --broadcast --chain sepolia -vvvv'
scripts.deploy:squad-admin-standalone-captain:ma: bash -c 'source .env && forge script DeploySquadAdminStandaloneCaptainHat --rpc-url mainnet --account $MAINNET_DEPLOYER_NAME --broadcast --chain mainnet -vvvv'
scripts.deploy:squad-admin-standalone-captain:se: bash -c 'source .env && forge script DeploySquadAdminStandaloneCaptainHat --rpc-url sepolia --account $SEPOLIA_DEPLOYER_NAME --broadcast --chain sepolia -vvvv'
